Maintain organised, versioned and accessible artefacts and packages through repository tooling such as JFrog Artifactory. Working experience with Ansible (playbooks, roles and inventory management) is also required. Certificate management and rotation: Hands-on experience managing the certificate lifecycle, including issuance, renewal, rotation and expiry monitoring, using internal or public certificate authorities and tooling such as AWS Certificate Manager. Ability to automate rotation safely across Linux, load balancer and Kubernetes environments. AWS cloud: Solid hands-on experience designing and operating AWS platforms, especially EC2, with a good understanding of IAM, S3, VPC and networking (for example Transit Gateway and Direct Connect). AWS Systems Manager: Practical experience using SSM for configuration and state management (State Manager, Run Command, Patch Manager, Parameter Store and automation documents). The AI & Cloud Security team is chartered to make that vision operational. We are seeking senior technical owner of the AI security runtime control plane and detection fabric. You will build and integrate the inline enforcement pipeline (AI gateway → runtime data protection → intent-based enforcement), tune the policies that keep it fast and low-friction, and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex AI and cloud security incidents. You will also help implement and participate in operation of a closed-loop defensive system in which continuous red-team findings automatically improve runtime policies, detection logic, and SOC threat models. You join a team of two AI & Cloud Security Architects and will be the engineering force that turns strategy into operating controls - across a multi-cloud estate (Azure, AWS, GCP). This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the security of AI and cloud environments, AI applications and infrastructure, addressing potential threats, and maintaining compliance with regulatory standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in AI technologies and their implementation as well as cloud security, security principles and cybersecurity best practices. The ability to develop automation in both AI and cloud environments with infrastructure as code (IaC) or policy as code principles is required. The engineer will report to AI & Cloud Security leadership and have strong working relationships with IT and application development leadership. Responsibilities Integration - build and own the AI runtime control plane. full_description: #JLLTechAmbitions JLL, an international real estate management company, is building AI into the way its teams work with enterprise data. Build RAG and agent solutions with Amazon Bedrock: implement foundation-model integrations, Knowledge Bases, Agents, and Guardrails, and manage prompts and model selection for cost, latency, and quality. Build on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP): develop in the AIDP Workbench using Master Catalog assets, Spark notebooks, and workflows; apply medallion (bronze, silver, gold) data patterns; and build knowledge bases and agent flows on governed enterprise data. Build on Oracle AI Database: implement AI Vector Search, hybrid (vector + relational) retrieval, Select AI natural-language-to-SQL interfaces, and in-database ML, with embedding pipelines and PL/SQL where needed. Integrate across platforms: connect Oracle data services with AWS-hosted AI applications through secure, well-defined APIs and swappable service interfaces. Engineer retrieval quality: own chunking and embedding strategy, metadata filtering, reranking, and retrieval tuning, and measure results with repeatable evaluations. Secure and govern AI: apply IAM least privilege, database-enforced access control (such as role-based access and data redaction), PII handling, and guardrails that screen for prompt injection and unsafe output. Keep audit trails of agent actions and outcomes. Test and evaluate: build evaluation and regression suites for LLM output, track hallucination and accuracy, and verify behavior end to end against real services, not only with unit tests. Deploy and operate: ship Python services (for example FastAPI) to production on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, and Secrets Manager. Monitor latency, quality, and cost with CloudWatch and AgentCore Observability. Collaborate and document: take part in sprint ceremonies and code and design reviews, and maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer material. Experience & Education 4-8 years of software, data, or AI/ML engineering experience, with hands-on delivery of generative AI or LLM-based applications in production or near-production. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is preferred. Proven experience building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows, including tool calling and multi-step orchestration. Experience with Amazon Bedrock and AWS-native deployment. Hands-on AgentCore experience is strongly preferred. Experience with Oracle Database or Oracle AI Database. Experience with the Oracle AI Data Platform is strongly preferred. Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, including tracing non-deterministic model behavior. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently in a distributed team. Technical Skills & Competencies Generative AI on AWS: Amazon Bedrock foundation models, Knowledge Bases, Agents, Guardrails, prompt engineering, and model evaluation; Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Observability, and built-in tools such as Code Interpreter). Oracle data and AI: Oracle AI Database (AI Vector Search, Select AI, in-database ML, PL/SQL) and Oracle AI Data Platform (Master Catalog, notebooks, workflows, knowledge bases, agent flows, OCI Generative AI integration). AI application engineering: RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), embedding strategy, chunking, reranking, and structured LLM output. AWS cloud: Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager. Programming: Python (primary), REST APIs, and SQL; FastAPI or similar async frameworks. Security and governance: IAM least privilege, data privacy controls, PII handling, and responsible-AI guardrails. Delivery: Agile/Scrum, Git and CI/CD, Docker, Jira and Confluence, and clear documentation. Preferred (Nice To Have) Experience with AgentCore Identity and Gateway for secure, tool-enabled agents. Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Apache Spark, or medallion-architecture data pipelines. Infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) and Kubernetes experience. Experience with agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, or with migrating Bedrock Agents to a code-first framework. Experience with LLM gateways, token and cost tracking, and usage analytics. Relevant certifications, such as AWS or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI certifications.

VuNet is Series B funded, part of NASSCOM DeepTech Club, awarded NASSCOM’s AI Gamechanger, recognized in Forbes DGEMS 200 and by several global analysts including Gartner, Omdia. We’re building a new category of observability purpose-built for complex digital journeys — across payments, lending, core banking and more — already powering some of the largest banks in India and MEA. Your Role: Lead - Platform & DevOps We are looking for a hands-on Platform & DevOps Lead to own and evolve the engineering platform on which VuNet products are built, released, deployed and operated. This role brings together our Platform and DevOps capabilities. VuNet runs across a mixed operating model: customer-managed on-premise environments, private cloud deployments and an increasing SaaS/cloud footprint. The engineering challenge Is therefore not only to operate infrastructure reliably, but to make installation, upgrades,releases and platform operations repeatable across very different environments. Today, some of this work still requires significant involvement from Platform, CARE and engineering teams. One of the key objectives of this role is to progressively make the platform self-sufficient, automated and supportable so that Customer Success teams, and eventually Qualified implementation partners, can perform standard installations and upgrades without deep Platform involvement. This is a lead engineering role, not a coordination role. You will remain handson, work through difficult production and platform problems, provide technical direction to the team and build stronger engineering capability across Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, reliability and cloud operations. As VuNet expands its SaaS and Cloud operations, this role is expected to grow in scope and can evolve into broader Platform leadership. Are you excited to be a part of VuNet's trailblazing team? Join VuNet and make a difference Roles & Responsibilities What You Will Own Platform Engineering Own the Kubernetes-based runtime platform used to deploy VuNet products across on-premise, private cloud and public cloud environments. Drive platform architecture, lifecycle management, upgrades, scaling, security, performance and reliability. Standardize environments and reduce customer-specific variations wherever possible. Build reusable platform capabilities instead of solving the same deployment and operational problems repeatedly. Customer Installation & Upgrades Own the engineering capability for installation, upgrades and platform lifecycle management across customer environments. Improve installers, upgrade tooling, environment validation, sizing, pre-flight checks, rollback and troubleshooting mechanisms. Move progressively towards self-service installation and upgrades. Enable Customer Success and implementation partners to handle standard deployments without requiring Platform engineers for every activity. Ensure difficult customer environments feed improvements back into the platform rather than remaining one-off operational fixes. DevOps & Release Engineering Own and evolve CI/CD and release engineering practices across the product. Build reliable pipelines for build, test, packaging, deployment and release. Drive GitOps, deployment automation and consistent release practices. Improve rollback, recovery, zero-downtime deployment and upgrade mechanisms. Work closely with Product Engineering and QA to improve release predictability and deployment quality. Cloud & Infrastructure Automation Build reusable cloud infrastructure patterns using Infrastructure as Code. Own provisioning and automation across compute, storage, networking, IAM and Kubernetes infrastructure. Support VuNet's move towards SaaS and private SaaS operating models. Over time, build the operational capability required for Cloud Ops and SaaS Ops. Reliability & Operations Establish strong operational practices for the platform. Own monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, infrastructure health and platform-level reliability. Lead investigation of complex infrastructure, Kubernetes and deployment issues. Drive high-quality RCA and ensure recurring incidents result in engineering improvements. Improve resilience, backup, recovery and operational readiness. Security Build security into the platform and deployment lifecycle. Own areas including Kubernetes hardening, RBAC, secrets management, container security, image scanning, vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security. Work closely with security teams to support BFSI customer and compliance requirements. Engineering Leadership Lead and mentor engineers across Platform and DevOps. Create clear primary and secondary ownership across critical platform capabilities. Reduce dependencies on individual engineers. Develop the team across Kubernetes, cloud, CI/CD, automation, troubleshooting and reliability engineering. Set technical direction while remaining close enough to the systems to step into difficult problems when required. Work closely with Product Engineering, QA, CARE, Customer Success and implementation teams. What You Bring Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production. Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, networking, storage, scheduling, security, upgrades, scaling and troubleshooting. Experience operating Kubernetes across on-premise and/or private-cloud environments in addition to managed Cloud Kubernetes. Strong experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for complex containerized products. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent. Strong understanding of Linux, networking, storage, containers and distributed system fundamentals. Production experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure or GCP. Strong scripting or programming skills using Python, Go, Bash or similar. Experience with monitoring and observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK or equivalent. Experience handling production incidents, RCA, capacity planning and infrastructure reliability. Experience supporting installation and upgrades of enterprise software across multiple customer environments. Experience leading engineers while remaining technically hands-on. High agency: identifies meaningful problems, forms hypotheses, prototypes solutions, validates them against data and drives successful approaches into production without waiting for detailed task definitions. Certification Strong Kubernetes certification is preferred, especially CKA or CKS. Cloud DevOps / SysOps certification in AWS or Azure or GCP is strongly preferred. Certifications should be backed by meaningful production experience operating these technologies at scale. Good To Have Experience building internal platforms or self-service infrastructure capabilities. Experience with Helm, operators, GitOps platforms and Kubernetes lifecycle automation. Experience with service meshes, ingress controllers, API gateways and K8S networking. Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments. Experience with SaaS operations, SRE or cloud operations. Experience operating within enterprise security and compliance environments such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or CIS benchmarks. Experience working with implementation partners or enabling third-party teams to deploy enterprise products What Makes Someone Successful in This Role The strongest candidate will start with Why does this deployment require manual intervention? Can we automate this once instead of solving it separately for every customer? How do we make upgrades safe, repeatable and reversible? How do we reduce the amount of specialist knowledge required to operate the platform? How do we make the platform ready for a larger SaaS and cloud footprint? Where are the current operational dependencies and how do we engineer them out? You should be equally comfortable discussing Kubernetes architecture with a senior engineer and debugging a broken deployment with the team. You should be willing to challenge existing operational practices rather than simply inherit them. Why This Role Matters Today, enterprise deployments require engineering expertise across Kubernetes, infrastructure, product packaging, upgrades and customer environments. That model will not scale as the number of customers and deployment models increase. At the same time, VuNet is expanding towards SaaS and cloud-operated environments, which introduces a different level of expectations around automation, reliability, scalability and operational ownership. This role exists to bridge those two worlds: make enterprise deployments substantially more self-sufficient while building the platform engineering foundation required for SaaS and Cloud Ops. What We Offer Life at VuNet: Building the Future Together At VuNet, we’re building a world-class observability platform, proudly Made in India — and we're just getting started. We’re a team of passionate problem-solvers who love tackling complex challenges. We learn fast, adapt quickly, and stay curious — especially when it comes to exploring and staying ahead of the curve with emerging technologies like Gen AI. More than just a tech company, VuNet is a place where collaboration, learning, and innovation are part of everyday life. We believe in working together, taking ownership, and growing as a team. If you’re looking to work on cutting-edge technology, make a real impact, and grow with a supportive team — you’ll feel right at home at VuNet. Transparent, Inclusive, and high-trust workplace culture. New Gen AI and integrated Technology workspace. Supportive career development programs to expand your skills and enhance expertise with various training programs.
